image_description: A yellow minibus parked on a paved street next to a curb with greenery. The bus features a digital destination sign, large windshield, side windows, and visible wheels. There is text on the front display and license plate area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits a compact, boxy profile consistent with a minibus, distinct from larger city buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield and multiple side windows are clearly visible along the side of the bus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus has significant height relative to its width, and the door placement appears standard for this vehicle type (front/mid).
The seam lines indicating a door are visible near the front wheel arch, consistent with a sliding or folding mechanism.
The front hood area is present and proportionate to a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the bus is not visible in this angle; only the front and side are shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus is painted bright yellow with black trim and visible text/markings on the side and front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel matches the scale and style of a heavy-duty van or light truck wheel.
The window configuration and overall size suggest a capacity within the minibus range.

artifact_observations.location: Front destination display and side text
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the LED destination board is illegible and resembles gibberish characters rather than clear letters. Side text is also slightly distorted/unreadable upon close inspection.
Reflections on the windshield appear somewhat smudged and lack crisp definition of the environment. Interior details through the glass are vague.
The geometry of the front bumper and headlights appears slightly soft and irregular, lacking the precise mechanical edges expected in real automotive photography.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle class and distinguish it from similar categories like full-size buses or vans.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and structure of the text artifacts observed on the front display and license plate.
To check for edge bleeding between the bus and background, and ensure wheel geometry is structurally sound.
To assess general image coherence, lighting consistency, and subtle texture anomalies.

focus_areas: Text legibility on destination board and license plate
Structural integrity of front bumper and headlights
Edge sharpness between bus body and background foliage
Wheel rim geometry and tire contact patch
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text generation quality on the bus's digital display. AI models often struggle with rendering coherent text on LED signs. Also, verify if the 'gibberish' text is severe enough to impact the realism score significantly. Check if the slight softness in the front bumper area indicates a deeper structural generation error or just compression/quality loss.
